title: He Runs This $29K/Month “Boring” Business From Home (Copy Him)
promo_conflict: The video is on the channel of Home Service Academy, the hosts' paid coaching programme. The guest is an HSA client, and the hosts pitch HSA throughout ("This is not a paid endorsement", blueprint calls). Revenue figures are loose: 15k 'organic and new sales' vs 29K for August, and 'under 10k' at the start vs 8K when he bought it.

stated_problem.quote: Dude, I'm only getting like barely three leads a month.

idea.offer: Residential house cleaning, with a satisfaction guarantee and recurring plans

acquisition_channels.details: Rebuilt the website with AI for about $600: local keywords, geo-tagging and a layout built to convert, copied from a Tommy Melo video. Leads went from about 3 to about 30 a month.
Live video testimonials on the Google Business page and website. Says no competitor in the market has them.
Direct mail blasts. They looked nice but were not built to convert: he spent a lot and got no return.

ideas.delivery: Local cleaners, hired and background-checked, do the cleans. VAs (apparently in the Philippines) take sales calls and follow up leads by text. The owner works remotely from Vegas on training, call reviews and marketing.
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR for customer data and call recordings. Cleaners' employment status, right-to-work checks and DBS checks. Employment Agencies Regs 2003 if cleaners are placed as an agency. Consumer Contracts Regs and the DMCC Act for recurring plans.

ideas.other_uk_rules: Doorstep sales trigger the Consumer Contracts Regs 2013: a 14-day cancellation right with written notice. Check local 'no cold calling' zones. Working-at-height rules apply.
